why: Lint cycle 11 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-11.md, lint-11.1 to lint-11.3 P2, lint-11.4 to lint-11.8 P3) converged: 0 P1 and 3 P2. The cycle 10 fixes hold. change: P2 first. lint-11.1: the class forms read a string literal inside a template literal's hole in a class position (className, cn(), cva), each branch of a conditional or `&&` there included, exactly as they read the template's own text and a ternary in className; this lifts the template-hole limit in scheme-fork's JSDoc too. lint-11.2: scheme-fork reads a cva/tv variant group whose keys are `dark` and `light` (a fork by itself, with no comparison), a `useMemo`/`useCallback` whose returned body is a scheme test bound to a const, and a media-query hook call (`useMediaQuery` from any package, usehooks-ts and react-responsive included) whose literal query is `(prefers-color-scheme: dark|light)`, as it reads `matchMedia(…).matches`. lint-11.3: chart-data-fallback and loader-deps-search climb `TSAsExpression`, `TSSatisfiesExpression`, `TSNonNullExpression` and parentheses before matching (`(q.data ?? []) as Row[]`, `search as S`, `({ ...(search as S) })`, a block body `const { page, ...rest } = search as S; return { page, ...rest }`), the way media-query climbs them since lint-10.6. P3s: lint-11.4, the scheme-store test also reads `document.documentElement.className = <scheme>` and a hand-written `setAttribute('data-theme', …)` / `dataset.theme =` on the root, with the setScheme fix. lint-11.5, form spellings: `-space-x-*`/`-space-y-*` in space-between; basalt's `Input` with `type="checkbox"`/`"radio"` in checkable-input; svg-data-marks reads `points` built through a const as it reads `d`; html-data-marks reads a computed custom property set on the JSX parent of the element whose class sizes by it; ui-path reads a relative specifier ending `ui/<shipped primitive name>`. lint-11.6: reader-loop reads `body` destructured from a parameter; raw-storage-write follows a const bound to a conditional with a storage branch; loader-deps-search reads `Object.assign({}, search)` as `({ ...search })`. lint-11.7: `apexcharts` joins the chart row; dangerous-html reads `setHTMLUnsafe` and `Document.parseHTMLUnsafe`; rehype-raw reads a re-export; media-query reads a touch probe (`navigator.maxTouchPoints`, `'ontouchstart' in window`) that chooses a layout class, its fix naming `pointer: coarse` for a hit target and the container for a layout. lint-11.8, messages: dark-fork's store report leads with the setScheme fix and drops the class-choice clause; platform-glyph names defineCommands' `Mod` chord for a test that picks a modifier key; shadcn/no-arbitrary-values' width clause names BarList, ui/progress and ui/meter for a width computed from data.
